newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota soybean harvest 81 percent complete.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota soybean harvest 81 percent complete.

text.p: Minnesota farmers had harvested 81 percent of their soybean crops as of Sunday, up from 20 percent the previous week, according to the Minnesota Agricultural Statistics Service.

"Soybean producers took advantage of very favorable harvest conditions to bring in over half of their crop during a single week, the weekly crop update said. "Percentage of soybeans harvested is the most advanced for this date since 1989."
Corn harvest was 15 percent complete as of Sunday, trailing the five-year average of 22 percent.
The average moisture content for corn was 29 percent, versus 26 percent for the five-year average.
Sugarbeets were 90 percent harvested as of Sunday, ahead of average pace of 64 percent.
Corn was rated one percent very poor, six percent poor, 32 percent fair, 53 percent good and eight percent excellent.
Soybeans were rated one percent very poor, seven percent poor, 30 percent fair, 52 percent good and 10 percent excellent.
Pasture and range conditions rated 11 percent very poor, 27 percent poor, 36 fair, 25 good and one percent excellent.
